description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSkillService within the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup and test methods to verify the behavior of EmployeeSkillService, particularly the getter and setter for EmployeeSkillDao.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeSkillService, testing DAO getter and setter methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeSkillService before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Tests if the getEmployeeSkillDao method returns an instance of EmployeeSkillDao.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSkillDaoBySetter
methods.description: Tests if the setter correctly assigns an EmployeeSkillDao and the getter returns an instance of EmployeeSkillDao.
